description: Use this when the signed-in owner wants a scheduled post not to go out. First call it without confirm: it says what would be cancelled and changes nothing. Show that to the owner, and call again with confirm true only after they say yes. The post stays approved, so it can be booked again with reschedule_post. A post that's already posted can't be taken down from here.

confirm.description: True only after the owner saw what will be cancelled and said yes

name: cancel_post
title: Cancel a booked post
